{{Quote|Yes, Teemo has a Kubaz spy. He's called Thweek.|[[Anatta]]|<ref name="LongArm" />}}
'''Thweek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and henchman employed by [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to oversee the shadier aspects of his business enterprises.

==Biography==
[[File:Thweek_GFH.png|thumb|left|200px|Thweek piloting his ''StarViper'']]
Thweek had a deep hatred of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] species and once killed a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] named [[Sivor]] after he had been forced to fight in a gladiatorial match for Teemo the Hutt's amusement. Thweek owned a customized [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] which he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] when Teemo sent him to intercept the ''[[Krayt Fang]]'' on its way to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="LongArm" /> He also owned a [[StarViper Mk. II|''StarViper'' Mk. II]].<ref name="GFH">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Thweek}}</ref> He wore laminate [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="LongArm" />

==Personality and traits==
Belonging to an insectivorous species, Thweek had an ingrained disdain for any insect species, and held particular hatred for Geonosians.<ref name="LongArm" /> He was known to be greedy, devious and brutal in his dealings. Thweek was a competent pilot, able to use his piloting skill to adapt to a wide array of situations.<ref name="FFG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thweek was designed by [[Dave Allen]] and [[Daniel Lovat Clark]] for ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2012]]. In it, his name was spelled Thwheek.<ref name="LongArm" /> His name was changed to Thweek on his card for the [[Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|''Guns for Hire'' Expansion Pack]], part of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game|X-Wing Miniatures Game]].<ref name="GFH" /> The retconned spelling was confirmed to be the same character in the preview for the expansion pack on the FFG website.<ref name="FFG" />
